The ai-tech category dominated ingestion at 107 articles, followed by news at 200 articles before filtering. Three new feeds entered the active subscription: Information Bulletins – BC Wildfire Service, Vancouver Sun, and blog.bgcarlisle.com, each scoring above 64.0 in discovery evaluation.
